Subject: Submission of Audio/Video Recording of Earnings Conference Call for the quarter and half 
year ended 30th September, 2026. 
 
Dear Sir/Madam 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015, we hereby inform you that the audio recording of the Earnings Call for the quarter and half 
year ended 30th September, 2026, held today, i.e., 31st October, 2026, has been uploaded on the 
Company's website and is available at the following weblink: 
 
https://cleanscience.co.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Recording_of_Con_call_31102026.mp3 
 
You are requested to take the same on record.  
 
Thanking You. 
 
For Clean Science and Technology Limited 
 
 
 
Ruchita Vij
